kind: reviewer recommendations for the owner, not applied in this build
common_finding: Every one of these 35 refreshed records is enabled, keeps its retained name and point, reports the generic FacilityTypeDescription 'Facility', is not reservable and has no campsite records. RIDB uses that pattern for non-reservable facilities, so it neither supports nor contradicts camping or a type. Each recommendation therefore rests on the retained own record (name and description) reviewed earlier.
